name: dev.toolc/toolc
description: Optimizing compiler and gateway for agent tool surfaces: many MCP servers or REST APIs in, one lean compiled MCP endpoint out. Benchmarked 5x cheaper per completed task with accuracy held.

packageArguments.description: Serve the compiled (or mirrored) tool surface over stdio
